title: GA activation record
description: Objective: assemble independent technical/product/benchmark reviews and, only after explicit GO_ACTIVATE, execute the one-way v2 activation evidence sequence. Deliverable: signed GA release and activation record for one exact commit/distribution/import generation. NOT in scope: automatic rollback, dual write, or an unscoped best-tool claim. Hard dependencies: every M5 task, successful Legacy quiesce drill, and explicit human GO_ACTIVATE. Owned paths: final release evidence and activation tooling only. Verification: all repository gates plus the release invariant checker.
definitionOfDone: All repository, property, fault, security, migration, integration, E2E, packaging, benchmark, and independent-review gates are PASS or explicitly non-applicable by the permit list.
GO_ACTIVATE binds the verified quiesce/import/backup/distribution generation and is distinct from GO_QUIESCE.
First authoritative v2 command occurs only after atomic activation; legacy remains locked/readable.
Release record permits only scoped claims supported by the exact evidence.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.
